title: .kritika.yaml
description: A repository's kritika configuration, read from the merge base. See docs/repository-config.md.

enabled.description: false stops reviews, follow-ups and indexing; true cannot turn a disabled repository on.

model.description: The model the review runs on, or a list of routes that ends with it, an entry with model alone: the first route one of whose conditions holds for a pull request picks its model instead. Replaces the admin's, routes and all; a list with a model of a provider the account may not use is dropped whole.

effort.description: How hard the review model, and the fallback that takes its step, reasons; replaces the admin's.

fixes.description: true requires a suggested fix on every finding; false cannot lift the admin's requirement.

approve.description: true approves a pull request whose review finds nothing at P0 or P1, or, with a confidence score, whose score reaches the threshold and whose risk is within confidence.risk; a later review that no longer allows it dismisses the approval; replaces the admin's. A block with when approves only a pull request one of its conditions holds for, beside the admin's conditions.

when.description: Conditions, one of which a pull request must hold for to be approved, as a rule's; an approval of one they stop holding for is dismissed.

diagram.description: true has the summary draw the flow the change adds or alters as a Mermaid diagram; replaces the admin's.

confidence.description: How a review is judged: a second model scores the reviewed pull request from 0 to 5.

model.description: The model that scores a reviewed pull request, replacing the admin's.

fallback.description: The model that takes the scorer's call when the confidence model fails, replacing the admin's.

effort.description: How hard the confidence model, and the fallback that takes its call, reasons; replaces the admin's.

threshold.description: The score a pull request must reach to be approved and, with gate, for its commit status to pass, replacing the admin's.

gate.description: true fails the commit status under the threshold, so it can be a required check; replaces the admin's. A block with when gates only a pull request one of its conditions holds for; another shows its score and passes.

when.description: Conditions, one of which a pull request must hold for to be gated, as a rule's.

risk.description: The highest risk a change may be rated and still be approved; it may only lower the admin's.

when.description: Conditions, one of which a pull request must hold for to be scored, as a rule's, beside the admin's; one they leave unscored is reviewed without a score and, where the admin asks for one, not approved.

trigger.description: Which pull requests get a review.

include.description: Conditions that let a pull request in: it is reviewed when any of them holds, or the list is empty, and no exclude condition does. It must pass the admin's lists as well.

exclude.description: Conditions that keep a pull request out: it is skipped when any of them holds, whatever include says. A skip names the condition that held when it has a name.

ignore.description: Globs of paths kritika leaves out of a review's context and of the index, added to the admin's; a pull request that changes only ignored paths is skipped.

summary.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces the summary comment's template.

finding.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces an inline finding's template.

rules.description: Checks the review makes, added after the admin's. A rule may not reuse the id of an admin's.

id.description: Names the rule to the findings that cite it.

file.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, whose content is the check.

paths.description: Apply the rule only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the rule applies only when one of them holds.

context.description: Files that explain the code, added after the admin's.

paths.description: Name the file only when a changed path matches one of these.

skills.description: The repository's Agent Skills: folders holding a SKILL.md, read from the merge base. A review is offered each one's name and description and reads the skill when it fits.

paths.description: The directories whose folders each hold a skill, replacing the admin's; .agents/skills and .claude/skills when no one sets them, and an empty list turns skills off.

scope.description: Narrows when a skill is offered, by the skill's name; added to the admin's, a skill named in both taking this file's.

paths.description: Offer the skill only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the skill is offered only when one of them holds.

load.description: Whether a review the skill applies to is given its instructions in the system prompt, rather than its name to read with load_skill. Unset, a scope with paths or when gives them, and one with neither offers the skill by name.

reviewers.description: Reviewers of the repository's own, run beside the default one and the admin's, each an agent of its own over the change, by name. Under the name of an admin's reviewer, only rules and skills may be added to it; the default reviewer is the admin's to turn off.

instructions.description: What the reviewer reviews for, added after kritika's own instructions.

file.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, whose content is the reviewer's instructions.

categories.description: The only finding categories the reviewer may report; every one when unset.

model.description: The reviewer's model; review.model's when unset.

fallback.description: The model that takes a step the reviewer's model fails; review.fallback's when unset.

effort.description: How hard the reviewer's models reason; review.effort's when unset.

paths.description: Review only the changed files that match one of these; a pull request that changes none is not reviewed by it.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the reviewer runs only when one of them holds.

rules.description: Checks the reviewer makes, in place of the repository's, which are the default reviewer's.

skills.description: Skill scopes laid over the repository's for this reviewer.

agent.description: Bounds of the reviewer's agent, each part of it in a split review; they may lower the repository's and never raise them.

tools.description: The tools the repository's reviews may run, over the image's, as mise's [tools] table: each key a registry short name (helm, crane) or a backend such as github:owner/repo, without a [options] or @version suffix, with its version or a table of the version and the download's options. A tool installs on the first use. Only the aqua, github, gitlab, http and ubi backends and the core tools are offered, a short name by the backend mise resolves it to: an install only downloads and unpacks. The http backend is offered only by a short name, whose commands the registry names: mise refuses filter_bins on it.

os.description: The operating systems the tool is for.

filter_bins.description: The commands the tool offers, among its executables.

asset_pattern.description: A glob the release asset's name matches.

additional_asset_patterns.description: Globs of further assets to download.

matching.description: A word the release asset's name contains, such as glibc.

matching_regex.description: A regular expression the release asset's name matches.

no_app.description: Whether the asset is the executable itself rather than an archive.

version_prefix.description: What the release tag has before the version, such as v.

url.description: The download's https:// URL, for the http backend.

format.description: The archive's format, when its name does not say.

strip_components.description: Leading path components to strip when unpacking.

bin_path.description: The directory under the install that holds the executables.

bin.description: The executables, for a download that does not name them.

exe.description: The executable's name within the archive.

extract_all.description: Whether to unpack every file rather than the executable alone.

symlink_bins.description: Whether to link the registry's commands alone, for an aqua recipe.

checksum.description: The download's checksum, as sha256:<hex>, which the install verifies.

size.description: The download's size in bytes, which the install verifies.

platforms.description: The same options per platform, such as linux-x64 or linux-arm64, each over the tool's own.

toolVersion.description: The version to run: a number, after an optional v. latest, lts, prefix:, sub-, ref:, tag:, branch:, rev: and path: requests are refused, since mise would resolve them anew on each install.

condition.description: One condition on a pull request, in trigger.include, trigger.exclude or a review.model route's when: expr, paths, or both, when both must hold. One with paths, or whose expr reads pr.lines, is judged once the pull request's diff is fetched.

name.description: What the condition is called where a skip or a route names it. In a trigger list it is unique in the list, and may not be one an admin's condition has.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr that says whether the condition holds. pr.lines is the lines the diff adds and removes, ignored paths left out.

paths.description: The condition holds only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: One condition on a pull request, in a rule's or a skill scope's when.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr, as a trigger.include or trigger.exclude expression sees it, without pr.lines.

defaultModel.description: The last entry of a review.model list: the model a pull request no route picks is reviewed on.

modelRoute.description: A route of review.model: the model a pull request one of its conditions holds for is reviewed on. The first route that holds picks the model.

name.description: What the summary's footer calls the route, beside the condition that held.

effort.description: How hard the route's model reasons, in place of review.effort.

fallback.description: The model that takes the review's step when the route's model fails, in place of review.fallback.

when.description: The conditions one of which a pull request must hold for the route to pick its model, judged over the whole pull request before its review starts.

model.description: A <provider>/<model> reference, of a provider the instance or the account declares.

effort.description: A reasoning effort, lowest first, or "" to leave it to the provider. Every provider takes low to max; the Anthropic Messages API has no level under low and gets none and minimal as low.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root.

glob.description: A doublestar glob, such as docs/** or **/*.sql.
